rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The ANC journal Mayibuye (March 1998), in 'Power to the people - We dare not fail', says the elections for the office bearers 'were held on the second day of conference' and those for the further 60 NEC members on Day 4, that 'Thabo Mbeki was unanimously elected as ANC President', that the only two contested positions were Deputy Secretary General and National Chairperson, and that the 'newly elected ANC President Thabo Mbeki' delivered a closing address.

locator.section: Article 'Power to the people - We dare not fail': paragraphs beginning 'Elections for the office bearers', 'Thabo Mbeki was unanimously elected' and 'Delivering his closing address'

bounded_scope: ANC President observations for CLAUDE-C01-16 only (role za_anc_president on the AFRICAN NATIONAL CONGRESS observation). Conference election, publication of results, acceptance, handover speeches, departure statements, deputy and chair offices and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Presidency of the Republic (za_presidency) is excluded and no row feeds it.
